preconditions.description: The input string consists only of digits and hyphens.
The length of the input string does not exceed 100,000 characters.

postconditions.description: The output date is a substring of the input string.
The output date is in the format 'dd-mm-yyyy'.
The year in the output date is between 2013 and 2015.
The month in the output date is between 1 and 12.
The day in the output date is valid for the given month and year.

postconditions.expression: all(stdin.count(date) <= stdin.count(return_value) for date in [d for d in stdin.split('-') if len(d) == 10 and d[2] == '-' and d[5] == '-' and 1 <= int(d[3:5]) <= 12 and 1 <= int(d[:2]) <= {31 if d[3:5] in ['01', '03', '05', '07', '08', '10', '12'] else 30 if d[3:5] in ['04', '06', '09', '11'] else 28} and d[6:] in ['2013', '2014', '2015']])
postconditions.description: The output date occurs more times in the input string than any other correct date.
